suggestions.layouts.title: Check for typos
suggestions.layouts.description: Check all layouts for typos and inconsistencies
suggestions.layouts.prompt:
Check ALL layouts in the open project for typos and inconsistencies.
Perform the audit, not just a plan. First verify the connection and the actual open Archicad project.
Work through the full set of objects. Read large responses in chunks or process them completely with Python; do not infer the whole project from the first fragment.
For each issue, state the sheet/view/element, current value or text, the problem and the proposed correction. Separate confirmed errors from decisions requiring an architect.
Summarize how many objects were found, how many were checked, what could not be checked and why. Do not claim completion while unchecked objects remain. Save a detailed report in the project folder if the work mode permits writing, and summarize findings in the conversation.
After the report, offer to fix all confirmed errors as one agreed batch. Until the user confirms that batch, do not change the model, save the PLN or change calculated geometry.
First retrieve and save the complete layout registry. Inspect every sheet: headings, numbers, title blocks, labels, notes, marks, symbols, units and repeated information across sheets. Compare spelling, numbering and cross-references.
For visual inspection, prepare PDF/images of sheets in the working folder using the available tools and current approval mode, then use view_image. Identify text available only in images and sheets that could not be read. Do not limit the audit to the current sheet or selected elements.
Name the report "Layout review". Finish by offering to fix confirmed errors throughout the entire checked set.
